ideas.title: Following the Money in the Feeding Our Future Case
ideas.description: Investigate the financial transactions and connections in the Feeding Our Future case to see if there are any other entities or individuals involved.
questions: What other entities or individuals are involved in the Feeding Our Future case?
How much money was involved in the scheme?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a larger fraud scheme and highlight the importance of following the money in investigations.
